Hi Sarah — I'd like to set up the CSE455 staff meeting for next week. My free slots are:

- Mon 10:00-10:30 or 14:00-14:30
- Tue 11:00-11:30 or 15:00-15:30
- Wed 10:00-10:30 or 13:00-13:30

Thursday and Friday are full for me. Which of these works with your schedule? If none do, tell me your free times and I'll see what I can move.

Hi Professor — happy to set it up. Checked my schedule: I'm free **Monday 10:00-10:30**, so that slot works for me.

Booked in my calendar: Monday 10:00-10:30, CSE455 staff meeting with you.

(For reference, the others don't work for me: Mon 14:00-14:30 is my seminar, Tue 11:00-11:30 is the seminar and Tue 15:30 onward is CSE455 office hours and quiz section; Wed 10:00-10:30 is your CSE455 office hours, and 13:00-13:30 runs into the quiz section.)

See you Monday.
Booked: Monday 10:00-10:30, CSE455 staff meeting, in my calendar too. See you Monday.
